projects.title: CLI-Craft Launcher
projects.description: A lightweight custom Minecraft launcher for Windows that lets you manage Minecraft versions, offline usernames, Java installations, Fabric modpacks, RAM allocation, and separate Minecraft instances — all from a simple terminal interface.
